An era of NFL football like no other | In 1968, the Cincinnati Bengals introduced "Benzoo," a live Bengal tiger cub that served as the team's mascot during home games. Provided by the Cincinnati Zoo, Benzoo was brought onto the field at halftime and became a beloved attraction among fans. Oftentimes players from the opposing teams were even drawn in for a closer look. The tradition was eventually phased out in the 1990s for practicality reasons, as new tigers were continually needed due to their rapid growth. #football #tiger #vintage #70s

The tiger (Panthera tigris) is the largest living cat species, recognised by its powerful body, sharp claws, muscular limbs, and distinctive orange coat covered in black stripes. Tigers are skilled hunters with exceptional night vision, strong jaws, and the ability to move quietly through dense vegetation. Unlike most cats, they are also excellent swimmers and often use rivers and lakes to cool down or travel. Tigers symbolise strength, courage, independence, and raw power. They inhabit forests, grasslands, mangroves, and other environments across parts of Asia. Unlike lions, tigers are generally solitary animals, patrolling large territories and hunting prey such as deer and wild boar. Despite their strength, they face serious threats from habitat loss, poaching, and conflicts with humans. Fun fact: Every tiger has a unique pattern of stripes, and the markings extend onto its skin beneath the fur. No two tigers have exactly the same stripe pattern.  #Tiger #PantheraTigris #Wildlife #BigCats #Nature
